SELECT kp.id,
    kp.kode_wilker,
    wr.nama AS nama_wilker,
    kp.tanggal,
    ew.minggu_epid AS epi_week,
    ew.tahun_epid AS tahun,
    kp.status_data,
    kp.maskapai,
    kp.keberangkatan,
    kp.kedatangan,
    kp.crew_berangkat,
    kp.penumpang_berangkat,
    kp.crew_datang,
    kp.penumpang_datang,
    (kp.sklt_male + kp.sklt_female) AS sklt_total,
    (kp.td_laik_male + kp.td_laik_female) AS td_laik_total,
    (kp.iaos_male + kp.iaos_female) AS iaos_total,
    (kp.jenazah_male + kp.jenazah_female) AS jenazah_total,
    (kp.kier_male + kp.kier_female) AS kier_total,
    ((((kp.sklt_male + kp.td_laik_male) + kp.iaos_male) + kp.jenazah_male) + kp.kier_male) AS total_sertifikat_male,
    ((((kp.sklt_female + kp.td_laik_female) + kp.iaos_female) + kp.jenazah_female) + kp.kier_female) AS total_sertifikat_female
   FROM ((kegiatan_pesawat kp
     JOIN wilker_ref wr ON ((wr.kode = kp.kode_wilker)))
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL mmwr_week(kp.tanggal) ew(tahun_epid, minggu_epid));

WITH asli_dasar AS (
         SELECT laporan_penyakit_emerging.tahun_epid,
            laporan_penyakit_emerging.bulan,
            laporan_penyakit_emerging.penyakit,
            laporan_penyakit_emerging.negara,
            laporan_penyakit_emerging.jumlah_kasus,
            laporan_penyakit_emerging.jumlah_kematian,
            (laporan_penyakit_emerging.sumber ~~ 'OWID%'::text) AS dari_owid
           FROM laporan_penyakit_emerging
          WHERE (laporan_penyakit_emerging.jenis_periode = 'bulanan'::text)
        ), asli_ada_owid AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT asli_dasar.tahun_epid,
            asli_dasar.bulan,
            asli_dasar.penyakit,
            asli_dasar.negara
           FROM asli_dasar
          WHERE asli_dasar.dari_owid
        ), asli AS (
         SELECT d.tahun_epid,
            d.bulan,
            d.penyakit,
            d.negara,
            sum(d.jumlah_kasus) AS jumlah_kasus,
            sum(d.jumlah_kematian) AS jumlah_kematian
           FROM asli_dasar d
          WHERE (d.dari_owid OR (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM asli_ada_owid o
                  WHERE ((o.tahun_epid = d.tahun_epid) AND (o.bulan = d.bulan) AND (o.penyakit = d.penyakit) AND (o.negara = d.negara))))))
          GROUP BY d.tahun_epid, d.bulan, d.penyakit, d.negara
        ), turunan AS (
         SELECT (EXTRACT(year FROM (epi_week_start(view_mingguan_penyakit_emerging.tahun_epid, view_mingguan_penyakit_emerging.minggu_epid) + 4)))::integer AS tahun_epid,
            (EXTRACT(month FROM (epi_week_start(view_mingguan_penyakit_emerging.tahun_epid, view_mingguan_penyakit_emerging.minggu_epid) + 4)))::integer AS bulan,
            view_mingguan_penyakit_emerging.penyakit,
            view_mingguan_penyakit_emerging.negara,
            view_mingguan_penyakit_emerging.total_kasus AS jumlah_kasus,
            view_mingguan_penyakit_emerging.total_kematian AS jumlah_kematian
           FROM view_mingguan_penyakit_emerging
        ), ada_asli AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT asli.tahun_epid,
            asli.bulan,
            asli.penyakit,
            asli.negara
           FROM asli
        )
 SELECT tahun_epid,
    bulan,
    penyakit,
    negara,
    sum(jumlah_kasus) AS total_kasus,
    sum(jumlah_kematian) AS total_kematian
   FROM ( SELECT asli.tahun_epid,
            asli.bulan,
            asli.penyakit,
            asli.negara,
            asli.jumlah_kasus,
            asli.jumlah_kematian,
            true AS prioritas
           FROM asli
        UNION ALL
         SELECT turunan.tahun_epid,
            turunan.bulan,
            turunan.penyakit,
            turunan.negara,
            turunan.jumlah_kasus,
            turunan.jumlah_kematian,
            false
           FROM turunan) g
  WHERE (prioritas OR (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM ada_asli a
          WHERE ((a.tahun_epid = g.tahun_epid) AND (a.bulan = g.bulan) AND (a.penyakit = g.penyakit) AND (a.negara = g.negara))))))
  GROUP BY tahun_epid, bulan, penyakit, negara;

WITH dasar AS (
         SELECT laporan_penyakit_emerging.tahun_epid,
            laporan_penyakit_emerging.minggu_epid,
            laporan_penyakit_emerging.penyakit,
            laporan_penyakit_emerging.negara,
            laporan_penyakit_emerging.jumlah_kasus,
            laporan_penyakit_emerging.jumlah_kematian,
            (laporan_penyakit_emerging.sumber ~~ 'OWID%'::text) AS dari_owid
           FROM laporan_penyakit_emerging
          WHERE (laporan_penyakit_emerging.jenis_periode = 'mingguan'::text)
        ), ada_owid AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT dasar.tahun_epid,
            dasar.minggu_epid,
            dasar.penyakit,
            dasar.negara
           FROM dasar
          WHERE dasar.dari_owid
        )
 SELECT tahun_epid,
    minggu_epid,
    penyakit,
    negara,
    sum(jumlah_kasus) AS total_kasus,
    sum(jumlah_kematian) AS total_kematian
   FROM dasar d
  WHERE (dari_owid OR (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM ada_owid o
          WHERE ((o.tahun_epid = d.tahun_epid) AND (o.minggu_epid = d.minggu_epid) AND (o.penyakit = d.penyakit) AND (o.negara = d.negara))))))
  GROUP BY tahun_epid, minggu_epid, penyakit, negara;

SELECT s.id,
    s.tahun_epid,
    s.minggu_epid,
    s.wilayah_kerja,
    s.jenis_penyakit_id,
    jp.jenis_penyakit,
    s.jumlah_kasus,
    round(avg(s.jumlah_kasus) OVER w, 2) AS rata2_4minggu,
    round(COALESCE(stddev_pop(s.jumlah_kasus) OVER w, (0)::numeric), 2) AS sd_4minggu,
    round((avg(s.jumlah_kasus) OVER w + ((2)::numeric * COALESCE(stddev_pop(s.jumlah_kasus) OVER w, (0)::numeric))), 2) AS ambang_atas,
        CASE
            WHEN (((s.jumlah_kasus)::numeric > (avg(s.jumlah_kasus) OVER w + ((2)::numeric * COALESCE(stddev_pop(s.jumlah_kasus) OVER w, (0)::numeric)))) AND (s.jumlah_kasus > 0)) THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS status_alert
   FROM (skdr_mingguan s
     JOIN skdr_jenis_penyakit jp ON ((jp.nomor = s.jenis_penyakit_id)))
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY s.wilayah_kerja, s.jenis_penyakit_id ORDER BY s.tahun_epid, s.minggu_epid ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
  ORDER BY s.wilayah_kerja, s.jenis_penyakit_id, s.tahun_epid, s.minggu_epid;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.status_lapor_bulanan(p_tahun integer, p_bulan integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(kode_wilker text, kegiatan text, jumlah bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select kode_wilker, 'DBD'::text, count(*)
  from vektor_dbd
  where extract(year from tgl_survei) = p_tahun
    and extract(month from tgl_survei) = p_bulan
    and kode_wilker in ('WK01','WK02','WK03','WK04','WK05','WK06','WK07')
  group by kode_wilker

  union all

  select kode_wilker, 'Tikus'::text, count(*)
  from vektor_tikus
  where extract(year from tgl_survei) = p_tahun
    and extract(month from tgl_survei) = p_bulan
    and kode_wilker in ('WK01','WK02','WK03','WK04','WK05','WK06','WK07')
  group by kode_wilker

  union all

  select kode_wilker, 'Anoph'::text, count(*)
  from vektor_anopheles
  where extract(year from tgl_survei) = p_tahun
    and extract(month from tgl_survei) = p_bulan
    and kode_wilker in ('WK01','WK02','WK03','WK04','WK05','WK06','WK07')
  group by kode_wilker

  union all

  -- Lalat: pecahan dari vektor_diare, jenis_kegiatan = 'lalat'
  select kode_wilker, 'Lalat'::text, count(*)
  from vektor_diare
  where extract(year from tgl_kegiatan) = p_tahun
    and extract(month from tgl_kegiatan) = p_bulan
    and lower(jenis_kegiatan) = 'lalat'
    and kode_wilker in ('WK01','WK02','WK03','WK04','WK05','WK06','WK07')
  group by kode_wilker

  union all

  -- Kecoa: pecahan dari vektor_diare, jenis_kegiatan = 'kecoa'
  select kode_wilker, 'Kecoa'::text, count(*)
  from vektor_diare
  where extract(year from tgl_kegiatan) = p_tahun
    and extract(month from tgl_kegiatan) = p_bulan
    and lower(jenis_kegiatan) = 'kecoa'
    and kode_wilker in ('WK01','WK02','WK03','WK04','WK05','WK06','WK07')
  group by kode_wilker

  union all

  -- TPP: wilayah_kerja berupa nama pendek, dipetakan ke kode_wilker
  select
    case wilayah_kerja
      when 'Samarinda' then 'WK01'
      when 'Tanjung Santan' then 'WK02'
      when 'Tanjung Laut' then 'WK03'
      when 'Lhoktuan' then 'WK04'
      when 'Sangatta' then 'WK05'
      when 'Sangkulirang' then 'WK06'
      when 'APT Pranoto' then 'WK07'
    end as kode_wilker,
    'TPP'::text,
    count(*)
  from tpp
  where extract(year from tanggal_kegiatan) = p_tahun
    and extract(month from tanggal_kegiatan) = p_bulan
    and wilayah_kerja in ('Samarinda','Tanjung Santan','Tanjung Laut','Lhoktuan','Sangatta','Sangkulirang','APT Pranoto')
  group by wilayah_kerja

  union all

  -- TTU: wilayah_kerja berupa nama pendek, dipetakan ke kode_wilker
  select
    case wilayah_kerja
      when 'Samarinda' then 'WK01'
      when 'Tanjung Santan' then 'WK02'
      when 'Tanjung Laut' then 'WK03'
      when 'Lhoktuan' then 'WK04'
      when 'Sangatta' then 'WK05'
      when 'Sangkulirang' then 'WK06'
      when 'APT Pranoto' then 'WK07'
    end as kode_wilker,
    'TTU'::text,
    count(*)
  from ttu
  where extract(year from tanggal) = p_tahun
    and extract(month from tanggal) = p_bulan
    and wilayah_kerja in ('Samarinda','Tanjung Santan','Tanjung Laut','Lhoktuan','Sangatta','Sangkulirang','APT Pranoto')
  group by wilayah_kerja

  union all

  -- PAB: wilayah_kerja berupa nama pendek, dipetakan ke kode_wilker
  select
    case wilayah_kerja
      when 'Samarinda' then 'WK01'
      when 'Tanjung Santan' then 'WK02'
      when 'Tanjung Laut' then 'WK03'
      when 'Lhoktuan' then 'WK04'
      when 'Sangatta' then 'WK05'
      when 'Sangkulirang' then 'WK06'
      when 'APT Pranoto' then 'WK07'
    end as kode_wilker,
    'PAB'::text,
    count(*)
  from pab
  where extract(year from tanggal) = p_tahun
    and extract(month from tanggal) = p_bulan
    and wilayah_kerja in ('Samarinda','Tanjung Santan','Tanjung Laut','Lhoktuan','Sangatta','Sangkulirang','APT Pranoto')
  group by wilayah_kerja;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.status_lapor_mingguan(p_tahun integer, p_minggu integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(kode_wilker text, kegiatan text, jumlah bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select a.kode_wilker, 'COP'::text, count(c.*)
  from wilker_nama_alias a
  join kegiatan_cop c on c.wilayah_kerja = a.wilayah_kerja_teks
  cross join lateral mmwr_week(c.tgl_kedatangan) w
  where w.tahun_epid = p_tahun and w.minggu_epid = p_minggu
    and a.kode_wilker in ('WK01','WK02','WK03','WK04','WK05','WK06')
  group by a.kode_wilker

  union all

  select a.kode_wilker, 'PHQC'::text, count(p.*)
  from wilker_nama_alias a
  join kegiatan_phqc p on p.wilayah_kerja = a.wilayah_kerja_teks
  cross join lateral mmwr_week(p.tgl_keberangkatan) w
  where w.tahun_epid = p_tahun and w.minggu_epid = p_minggu
    and a.kode_wilker in ('WK01','WK02','WK03','WK04','WK05','WK06')
  group by a.kode_wilker

  union all

  select k.kode_wilker, 'Pesawat'::text, count(k.*)
  from kegiatan_pesawat k
  cross join lateral mmwr_week(k.tanggal) w
  where w.tahun_epid = p_tahun and w.minggu_epid = p_minggu
    and k.kode_wilker = 'WK07'
    and k.status_data = 'final'
  group by k.kode_wilker;
$function$
